name: ls
description: Lists directory contents, showing file names, permissions, sizes, and modification dates.
impact_reason: Reads filesystem directory contents without modifying files.

name: cd
description: Changes the current working directory of the active shell session.
impact_reason: Changes session state (the active working directory).

name: pwd
description: Prints the absolute pathname of the current working directory.
impact_reason: Reads and prints the current directory location.

name: mkdir
description: Creates one or more new directories.
impact_reason: Creates new directory entries on the filesystem.

name: cp
description: Copies files and directories to a specified destination.
impact_reason: Writes duplicate copies of files or directories to disk.

name: mv
description: Moves or renames files and directories.
impact_reason: Changes filesystem paths and filenames.

name: rm
description: Removes (deletes) files or directory trees permanently from the filesystem.
impact_reason: Permanently unlinks and deletes files from the filesystem.

name: touch
description: Creates an empty file if it does not exist, or updates access and modification timestamps.
impact_reason: Creates new files or alters existing file timestamps.

name: chmod
description: Changes the access permissions (read, write, execute) of files and directories.
impact_reason: Modifies file permission modes stored in inode metadata.

name: chown
description: Changes user and group ownership of files and directories.
impact_reason: Alters user and group ownership attributes of filesystem items.

name: grep
description: Searches text or files for lines matching a specified regular expression pattern.
impact_reason: Inspects file contents without modifying them.

name: cat
description: Concatenates and displays file contents to standard output.
impact_reason: Reads file contents and prints them to terminal output.

name: less
description: Interactive text viewer that allows forward and backward navigation through large files.
impact_reason: Opens an interactive viewer to inspect file contents.

name: head
description: Outputs the beginning lines (first 10 by default) of files.
impact_reason: Reads and displays the top lines of files.

name: tail
description: Outputs the last part of files; commonly used with -f to monitor logs in real time.
impact_reason: Reads and watches new lines appended to a file.

name: find
description: Recursively searches directory hierarchies for files matching criteria such as name, size, or type.
impact_reason: By default find only searches and reads, but flags like -delete or -exec can delete or alter files.

name: sed
description: Stream editor for filtering, parsing, and transforming text data.
impact_reason: Without -i it prints transformed text to stdout (read-only), but with -i it alters files in place.

name: awk
description: Pattern scanning and processing language for structured data and column extraction.
impact_reason: Scans input streams or files and outputs formatted text.

name: wc
description: Counts and displays newline, word, and byte/character counts for files.
impact_reason: Calculates line, word, or byte counts without altering files.

name: diff
description: Compares files line by line and highlights differences.
impact_reason: Reads two files and computes line differences.

name: sort
description: Sorts lines of text files in alphabetical or numerical order.
impact_reason: Reads input lines, sorts them, and outputs to standard output.

name: ps
description: Reports a snapshot of the currently active processes on the system.
impact_reason: Queries the kernel /proc filesystem for process state without terminating anything.

name: top
description: Provides an interactive, real-time view of system processor, memory, and running tasks.
impact_reason: Inspects and displays real-time CPU and memory metrics.

name: kill
description: Sends a specified signal (such as TERM or KILL) to processes by process ID (PID).
impact_reason: Sends termination signals to shut down or kill running processes.

name: df
description: Reports file system disk space usage across mounted storage devices.
impact_reason: Queries filesystem mount statistics and reports available space.

name: du
description: Estimates file and directory space usage recursively on disk.
impact_reason: Traverses files and directories to calculate disk consumption.

name: free
description: Displays total, used, and available physical memory (RAM) and swap space in the system.
impact_reason: Reads memory statistics from the kernel without modifying system state.

name: uname
description: Prints kernel, architecture, hostname, and operating system information.
impact_reason: Reads operating system name and kernel version string.

name: systemctl
description: Controls the systemd system and service manager to inspect or control services.
impact_reason: Commands like 'status' only inspect state, but 'start', 'stop', 'restart', or 'enable' modify system services.

name: curl
description: Command-line tool for transferring data with network URLs (HTTP, HTTPS, FTP).
impact_reason: Fetches HTTP headers from the target server; does not write to local disk without output flags.

name: ping
description: Sends ICMP ECHO_REQUEST packets to network hosts to test reachability and latency.
impact_reason: Sends network probe packets and displays timing statistics.

name: tar
description: Creates, inspects, and extracts compressed archive files (.tar, .tar.gz, .tgz).
impact_reason: -c creates new archives (modifies disk), -t lists contents (reads), and -x extracts and overwrites files.

name: ssh
description: Secure Shell client for logging into and executing commands on remote machines.
impact_reason: Connects to a remote terminal where remote operations could read, write, or delete data.

name: rsync
description: Fast and versatile file-copying tool for local and remote synchronizations.
impact_reason: Transfers and updates files on destination; if --delete is used, it deletes destination files not in source.

name: sudo
description: Executes a command with superuser (root) or alternative user privileges.
impact_reason: Elevation wrapper; the actual effect depends entirely on the command executed with root privileges.
